Dilip Singh (driver) was formally arrested on 25.03.2021 and released on police bail and offence under section 338 IPC was added on the basis of final opinion upon MLC of injured Bablu.
Separate Kalandra under section 5/180 M.V Act was prepared against Byas Kumar (Regd. Owner) after Dalip Singh failed to produce valid and effective licence for driving the vehicle.
